rawTimingScope: ON retains all600 ordered measured durations; OFF has no per-tick clocks as original protocol and is explicitly null, not reconstructed.
incrementalScope: External whole-controller elapsed minus wrapped physical-port elapsed; includes admission, arbitration, realization, actuation dispatch, descriptor validation and two extra clocks. Packet preparation and semantic assertions occur outside sampled controller timing. Elapsed wall total includes them and remains diagnostic. Not a separately isolated algorithm timer.
